Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Elia Morun: 20-year-old man, 186 cm (tall), ordinary lean-to-average construction without visible definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: heart-shaped face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a string-bound recipe leaf only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
